harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: The governing word of «إذا» is implied (muqaddar) from the meaning of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), i.e.: a group remains. The lām in His saying «فلتقم» is for the imperative; the preposition phrase «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «طائفة»; and «معك» is an adverb attached to «تقم». «لو» is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the implied form is: they wished for your heedlessness. The clause «فيميلون» is conjoined to «تغفلون» and has no grammatical position. The maṣdar «أن تضعوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition («في»).

harrat-mujtaba:103-103.t: (فإذا قضيتم الصلاة) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is resumptive, and His saying «قياما» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw. The preposition phrase «على جنوبكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied ḥāl, i.e.: and being on your sides. The preposition phrase «على المؤمنين» is attached to a ḥāl of «كتابا».

harrat-mujtaba:104-104.t: The clause «إن تكونوا تألمون» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «تهنوا». «كما»: the kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the implied form is: they suffer pain like your pain. The clause «وكان الله عليما» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:105-105.t: The preposition phrase «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الكتاب». The preposition phrase «للخائنين» is attached to the khabar (predicate) «خصيما».

harrat-mujtaba:107-107.t: The clause «إن الله لا يحب ...» is parenthetical, between the ḥāl (circumstantial) and the one it qualifies.

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: The clause «يستخفون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in ﴿يَخْتَانُونَ﴾. The clause «وهو معهم» is a ḥāl of the pronoun in «يستخفون». «إذ يبيتون»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the notion of existence (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached, and the clause «يبيتون» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The preposition phrase «من القول» is attached to a ḥāl of the omitted object of «يرضى»; the implied form is: what He does not approve of, being of speech.

harrat-mujtaba:109-109.t: His saying «ها أنتم هؤلاء جادلتم»: «ها» is for drawing attention, and «أنتم» is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). «هؤلاء»: the hāʾ is for drawing attention, and «أولاء» is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of the accusative by specification (al-ikhtiṣāṣ). The clause «جادلتم» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the clause «أخصُّ هؤلاء» is parenthetical. «فمن يجادل»: the fāʾ links to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if the matter is so, then who will argue? The clause «أم من يكون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:110-110.t: «مَنْ» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «يعمل» is the khabar (predicate). «غفورا» is the second object, and «رحيما» belongs to the category of multiple second objects, by analogy with multiple khabars.

harrat-mujtaba:111-111.t: The clause «وكان الله عليما» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:112-112.t: «يرم» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), conjoined to «يكسب», and the sign of its jussive is the dropping of the weak letter.

harrat-mujtaba:113-113.t: The preposition phrase «عليك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «فضل». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يضلوك» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ; the clause «وما يضلُّون» is a ḥāl; and His saying «من شيء» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), with «من» redundant (zāʾida), i.e.: they do not harm you with any harm, little or much. «ما» in His saying «وعلّمك ما» is the second object. The clause «وكان فضل الله» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:114-114.t: «لا خير»: [«لا» is] the lā of generic negation, its noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The preposition phrase «من نجواهم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «كثير». «إلا من»: a disconnected excepted (mustathnā munqaṭiʿ), and the adverb «بين الناس» is attached to a naʿt of «إصلاح».

harrat-mujtaba:115-115.t: (من بعد ما تبين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «ما» is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «وساءت مصيرا» is resumptive, and «مصيرا» is tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:116-116.t: The preposition phrase «لمن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يغفر».

harrat-mujtaba:117-117.t: «إن يدعون»: «إن» is negating, and «إناثا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:118-118.t: The clause «لعنه الله» is a naʿt (adjective) of «شيطان», in the position of the accusative. The clause «لأتخذنَّ» is the reply to the oath, and the oath with its reply is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:119-119.t: The clause «ولأضلنَّهم» is conjoined to the clause ﴿لأَتَّخِذَنَّ﴾, and there is no new oath. «فليبتكّن»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, the lām occurs in the reply to the oath, and the verb is an imperfect, nominative by the retention of the nūn, which has been dropped because of a succession of like letters; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescents, is the fāʿil (agent), and the nūn is for emphasis. The preposition phrase «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «وليا».

harrat-mujtaba:120-120.t: The clause «يعدهم» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «ما يعدهم الشيطان». «غرورا»: a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: a promise of delusion.

harrat-mujtaba:121-121.t: The clause «مأواهم جهنم» is the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك», and the clause «ولا يجدون» is conjoined to the clause «مأواهم جهنم».

harrat-mujtaba:122-122.t: «وعد الله حقا»: [«وعد» is] a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, and likewise «حقا». The clause «ومن أصدق» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and «قيلا» is tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:123-123.t: The noun of «ليس» is a pronoun referring back to what the wording indicates, namely faith, understood from His saying ﴿وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾. The preposition phrase «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «وليا».

harrat-mujtaba:124-124.t: The preposition phrase «من ذكر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يعمل». The clause «وهو مؤمن» is a ḥāl. His saying «نقيرا» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: a wrong the measure of a speck (naqīr).

harrat-mujtaba:125-125.t: His saying «دينا» is tamyīz (specification). The preposition phrase «ممن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أحسن». His saying «حنيفا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «إبراهيم», and a ḥāl of the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) is permitted because the muḍāf is like a part of the muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «وهو محسن» is a ḥāl of the pronoun in «أسلم». «خليلا» is the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:126-126.t: The preposition phrase «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). The preposition phrase «بكل» is attached to «محيطا».

harrat-mujtaba:127-127.t: His saying «وما يتلى عليكم»: a relative noun conjoined to the Divine Name. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تنكحوهن» is accusative by removal of the preposition «في». «والمستضعفين» is a noun conjoined to «يتامى». The maṣdar «أن تقوموا» is conjoined to «المستضعفين». The preposition phrase «بالقسط» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «تقوموا», i.e.: bound up with justice. «وما تفعلوا من خير»: the wāw is resumptive, «ما» is conditional, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the preposition phrase «من خير» is attached to an adjective (ṣifa) of «ما».

harrat-mujtaba:128-128.t: (وإن امرأة خافت) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is resumptive and «إن» is conditional; «امرأة» is the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb explained by what follows, and the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «نشوزا». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يصلحا» is accusative by removal of the preposition («في»). «صلحا» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it is a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar). The clause «والصلح خير» is parenthetical, and the clause «وأحضرت الأنفس» is conjoined to the parenthetical one. The clause «إن تحسنوا» is conjoined to the clause «وإن امرأة خافت».

harrat-mujtaba:129-129.t: The clause «ولو حرصتم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), in the position of the accusative, and the wāw is ḥāliyya, conjoining to an implied ḥāl, i.e.: you will not be able in any state, even in the state of eagerness; this is for exhausting all states, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it. His saying «كل الميل» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). «فتذروها كالمعلقة»: the fāʾ is causal, and the verb is accusative by «أن» necessarily concealed after the fāʾ; the maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: let there be no inclining from you, and so leaving; and the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of the hāʾ in «تذروها».

harrat-mujtaba:130-130.t: The preposition phrase «من سعته» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يُغْنِ».

harrat-mujtaba:131-131.t: The clause «ولقد وصَّينا الذين» is resumptive, and the clause «لقد وصينا» is the reply to the oath. His saying «وإياكم»: a detached accusative pronoun conjoined to «الذين», and «كم» is for address. «أن» in «أن اتقوا» is explicative (mufassira), and the clause «اتقوا» explains the injunction and has no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:133-133.t: The clause «أيها الناس» is parenthetical, with no grammatical position, and «الناس» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of «أي».

harrat-mujtaba:134-134.t: «مَنْ» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «كان» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:135-135.t: The preposition phrase «بالقسط» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قوامين», and the preposition phrase «لله» is attached to «شهداء». His saying «ولو على أنفسكم»: the wāw is ḥāliyya, conjoining to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: be so in every state, even in the state of the testimony being settled against yourselves; and the preposition phrase is attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of an implied «كان», i.e.: even if the testimony were settled against yourselves; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it. His saying «فالله أولى بهما»: the fāʾ conjoins to the omitted apodosis, i.e.: and if the one testified against is rich or poor, let him testify against him, for Allah is more entitled to both kinds, rich and poor. His saying «فالله ...» is not the apodosis of the condition; rather it indicates it, because the conjoining is with «أو», so agreement [in number] is not permitted: you say «زيد أو عمرو أكرمته», and «أكرمتهما» is not permitted. His saying «فلا تتبعوا»: the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if the matter is so, then do not follow; and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تعدلوا» is mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: out of love of being just.

harrat-mujtaba:137-137.t: «كفرا» is tamyīz (specification), because the form iftaʿala from «زاد» is intransitive. His saying «ليغفر لهم»: the verb is accusative by «أن» necessarily concealed after the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), and the interpreted maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied khabar (predicate) of «كان»: intending. The clause «يغفر» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī), with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:139-139.t: The preposition phrase «من دون المؤمنين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أولياء». His saying «فإنّ العزة لله جميعا»: the fāʾ links to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if the matter is so; and «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the latent pronoun in the notion of existence (al-istiqrār) that serves as khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:140-140.t: His saying «أن إذا سمعتم»: «أن» is lightened from the heavy form, its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), the maṣdar (verbal noun) is the object of «نزل», and the conditional clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of «أن». The clause «يكفر بها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «آيات», in the position of the accusative. His saying «غيره» is a naʿt (adjective) of «حديث», and the clause «إنكم إذًا مثلهم» is resumptive. «إذًا» is a particle of reply with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:141-141.t: «الذين» is a badal (substitute) of His earlier saying «الكافرين». The clause «فإن كان لكم» is conjoined to the clause «يتربصون». The clause «فالله يحكم بينكم» is resumptive, and the preposition phrase «على المؤمنين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «سبيلا».

harrat-mujtaba:142-142.t: The clause «وهو خادعهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the Divine Name, and His saying «كسالى» is a ḥāl of the wāw; the clause «يراءون» is a ḥāl of the pronoun in «كسالى», in the position of the accusative. The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «يخادعون», in the position of the nominative. «قليلا»: a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its adjective standing in for it.

harrat-mujtaba:143-143.t: «مذبذبين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿يُرَاءُونَ﴾, the adverb «بين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مذبذبين», and the preposition phrase «إلى هؤلاء» is attached to an implied ḥāl, i.e.: not ascribed to these.

harrat-mujtaba:144-144.t: «أولياء» is the second object, and the preposition phrase «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أولياء»; the clause «أتريدون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The preposition phrase «لله» is attached to the second object. The preposition phrase «عليكم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «سلطانا».

harrat-mujtaba:145-145.t: The clause «ولن تجد» is conjoined to the implied khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ», by way of conjoining a clause to a single word, in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:146-146.t: «يؤت»: an imperfect verb, nominative by the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ that is dropped in writing because of the meeting of two quiescents. The clause «وسوف يؤت» is conjoined to the resumptive clause before it.

harrat-mujtaba:147-147.t: «ما» is an interrogative noun, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «إن شكرتم» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it.

harrat-mujtaba:148-148.t: The preposition phrase «بالسوء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الجهر», and the preposition phrase «من القول» is attached to a ḥāl of «السوء». His saying «من ظلم»: a relative noun, excepted, i.e.: except the speaking aloud of one who has been wronged.

harrat-mujtaba:149-149.t: (فإن الله كان عفوا قديرا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The link between the condition and the apodosis is implied (muqaddar), i.e.: pardoning you.

harrat-mujtaba:150-150.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن يفرقوا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:151-151.t: «أولئك»: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is «الكافرون»; «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position. «حقا»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) confirming the content of the clause. The clause «وأعتدنا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:152-152.t: The clause «أولئك سوف يؤتيهم» is the khabar (predicate) of the relative «الذين»; «أجورهم» is the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:153-153.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تنزل» is the second object, and the preposition phrase «من السماء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كتابا». The clause «فقد سألوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if you marvel at their asking. His saying «جهرة» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: an open seeing. «ما» is maṣdariyya in His saying «من بعد ما جاءتهم», and the maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:154-154.t: «سجَّدا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «ادخلوا».

harrat-mujtaba:155-155.t: (فبما نقضهم ميثاقهم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The fāʾ is resumptive, the bāʾ is a preposition, «ما» is redundant (zāʾida), and «نقضهم» is a genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied verb, i.e.: We cursed them; «ميثاقهم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the maṣdar «نقض», and the implied clause «لعنّاهم» is resumptive. The preposition phrase «بغير حق» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «قتلهم», and «حق» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «قليلا»: a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: except a little faith. The clause «فلا يؤمنون» is conjoined to the clause «طبع».

harrat-mujtaba:156-156.t: The preposition phrase «على مريم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) «قولهم», and «بهتانا» is the object of the maṣdar.

harrat-mujtaba:157-157.t: The clause «وما قتلوه» is resumptive. The clause «ولكن شُبّه» is conjoined to the clause «صلبوه», in the position of the accusative, and the clause «وإن الذين ...» is conjoined to the clause «شُبّه». The clause «ما لهم به من علم» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items; «علم» is mubtadaʾ (subject), «من» is redundant (zāʾida), and «اتباع» is a disconnected excepted (mustathnā munqaṭiʿ). The clause «وما قتلوه» is conjoined to the first clause «ما قتلوه», and «يقينا» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: a certain killing.

harrat-mujtaba:159-159.t: (وإن من أهل الكتاب) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is resumptive, «إن» is negating, and the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); the implied form is: and there is no one, being of the People of the Book, but that, by Allah, he will surely believe in him; and the oath clause is the khabar (predicate). The adverb «يوم القيامة» is attached to «شهيدا». The clause «يكون» is conjoined to the resumptive nominal clause «وإن من أهل الكتاب».

harrat-mujtaba:160-160.t: His saying «فبظلم»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «حرّمنا»; the clause «حرّمنا» is conjoined to the implied clause «لعنَّاهم» in verse (155). His saying «كثيرا» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the object of «الصدّ» is implied, i.e.: people.

harrat-mujtaba:161-161.t: The clause «وقد نهوا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الربا».

harrat-mujtaba:162-162.t: «الراسخون» is mubtadaʾ (subject); «في العلم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «الراسخون»; the preposition phrase «منهم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الراسخون»; «والمؤمنون» is a noun conjoined to «الراسخون»; the clause «يؤمنون» is the khabar (predicate) of «الراسخون». His saying «والمقيمين»: the object of an implied «أمدح» (I praise), and the clause is parenthetical between the conjoined items. His saying «والمؤتون»: mubtadaʾ; «والمؤمنون» is a noun conjoined to «المؤتون»; the clause «أولئك سنؤتيهم» is the khabar of «المؤتون»; and the clause «أولئك سنؤتيهم» is conjoined to the clause «لكن الراسخون يؤمنون». [Translator's note: so in the source; the clause conjoined to «لكن الراسخون يؤمنون» is presumably the whole clause «والمؤتون ... أولئك سنؤتيهم».]

harrat-mujtaba:163-163.t: «كما أوحينا»: the kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e.: a revealing like Our revealing.

harrat-mujtaba:164-164.t: His saying «ورسلا»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «رسلا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «وقصصنا»; the implied clause «وقصصنا» is conjoined to the clause ﴿وَآتَيْنَا﴾ and has no grammatical position; the mentioned clause «قصصنا» is explicative, with no grammatical position, and «رسلا لم نقصصهم» likewise. The clause «وكلّم الله» is conjoined to the implied clause «لم نقصص», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:165-165.t: «رسلا» is a badal (substitute) of the earlier «رسلا». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «لئلا يكون» is genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «منذرين». The preposition phrase «على الله» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «حجة», the noun of «يكون», and «بعد» is an adverb attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «حجة».

harrat-mujtaba:166-166.t: «لكن» is a particle of rectification (istidrāk) with no governing effect; the clause «أنزله» is parenthetical between the conjoined items; the clause «والملائكة يشهدون» is conjoined to the clause «الله يشهد»; and the bāʾ in the Divine Name is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:169-169.t: «طريق» is a connected excepted (mustathnā muttaṣil), and the clause «وكان ذلك» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:170-170.t: The clause «فآمنوا» is conjoined to the reply to the vocative, and His saying «خيرا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, i.e.: and bring good; the preposition phrase «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خيرا». His saying «خيرا»: an elative (afʿal al-tafḍīl) whose hamza has been dropped for lightness, and likewise «شر». The clause «وأْتُوا» is conjoined to the clause «آمنوا».

harrat-mujtaba:171-171.t: «الحق» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: except the true saying; the clause «ألقاها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «كلمة». His saying «ثلاثة»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being «هم»; His saying «خيرا»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied verb, i.e.: «وَأْتوا»; and the clause «إنما المسيح» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. His saying «سبحانه»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, and the clause is resumptive. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يكون له ولد» is accusative by removal of the preposition («عن»). «بالله» is the fāʿil (agent) of «كفى», and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:172-172.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يكون» is accusative by removal of the preposition («عن»). His saying «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «يحشرهم».

harrat-mujtaba:173-173.t: «أمَّا» is a particle of condition and detailing. «عذابا» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it is a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar), the maṣdar being «تعذيب»; and the preposition phrase «من دون الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «وليا».

harrat-mujtaba:174-174.t: The preposition phrase «من ربكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «برهان». The clause «أنزلنا» is conjoined to the clause «جاءكم».

harrat-mujtaba:175-175.t: The clause «فسيدخلهم» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate). His saying «صراطا» is the second object; the preposition phrase «منه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة».

harrat-mujtaba:176-176.t: His saying «إن امرؤ هلك»: «إن» is conditional, and «امرؤ» is the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb explained by what follows; the clause is resumptive within the scope of the speech (al-qawl); the clause «ليس له ولد» is a naʿt (adjective) of «امرؤ»; the clause «إن لم يكن لها ولد» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it. His saying «رجالا»: a badal (substitute), accusative; and the clause «وهو يرثها» is conjoined to the clause «إن امرؤ هلك». The clause «يبين» is resumptive. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تضلُّوا» is mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: out of dislike. The clause «والله عليم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The preposition phrase «بكل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عليم».

harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «الذي»: a relative noun, a naʿt (adjective) of the Divine Name. «والأرحام»: a noun conjoined to the Divine Name, accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The preposition phrase «إلى أموالكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أموالهم».

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: His saying «ما طاب لكم من النساء»: «ما» is used for rational beings because it refers to the kind. The preposition phrase «من النساء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما». «مثنى» is a ḥāl of «ما», and it is a diptote because of being adjectival and because of being diverted (ʿadl) from the repeated «اثنين»; the word applies to masculine and feminine alike; and «ثُلاث» is diverted from the repeated «ثَلاث». «فواحدةً»: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and «واحدة» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied verb, i.e.: «فانكحوا» (then marry). The clause «ذلك أدنى» is resumptive. And the maṣdar (verbal noun) «ألا تعولوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition «إلى». [Translator's note: the quotation marks in the middle of this entry are misplaced in the source; it has been translated according to the evident sense.]

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «نحلة»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), being a synonym of its governing word. His saying «فإن طِبنَ لكم عن شيء»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the two preposition phrases are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «طبن»; the preposition phrase «منه» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «شيء»; «نفسا» is tamyīz (specification); «هنيئا» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq, being a naʿt of the maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: a wholesome eating, and likewise «مريئًا». And the clause «فإن طبن» is conjoined to the clause «آتوا», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: His saying «حتى إذا بلغوا»: «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), and «إذا» is adverbial-conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the sense of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause «حتى إذا بلغوا» is resumptive. The clause «فإن آنستم» is the apodosis of «إذا», with no grammatical position, and the clause «فادفعوا» is the apodosis of «إن», in the position of the jussive. «إسرافا»: a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial), and «وبدارا» is conjoined to «إسرافا». The maṣdar «أن يكبروا» is mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: for fear that they grow up. «وكفى بالله حسيبا»: the wāw is resumptive, «كفى» is a past verb, «بالله» is the fāʿil (agent) with the bāʾ redundant (zāʾida), and «حسيبا» is tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The preposition phrase «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «نصيب». «ممّا قلّ منه»: the preposition phrase «مما» is a badal (substitute) of the preceding «مما». «نصيبا»: an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The wāw is resumptive, and the lām is for command; making it vowelless is a lightening, and its original vowel is kasra; the object of «يخش» is implied (muqaddar), i.e.: «الله». The clause «خافوا» is the apodosis of «لو», and the non-jussive conditional clause with its apodosis is the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal relative. And the clause «فليتقوا» is conjoined to the clause «وليخش الذين».

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «ظلما» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «إنما يأكلون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ». And «إنما» is the restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa makfūfa), with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «للذكر مثل حظ الأنثيين» is explicative, with no grammatical position. His saying «فوق اثنتين»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «نساء». The clause «إن كان له ولد» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes. The preposition phrase «مما» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «السدس». The preposition phrase «من بعد وصية» is attached to an implied verb, i.e.: «يستحقون ذلك» (they are entitled to that), and the implied clause «يستحقون ذلك» is resumptive. His saying «لا تدرون أيهم أقرب لكم نفعا»: «أيهم»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi, and «أقرب» is its khabar (predicate). The preposition phrase is attached to «أقرب», «نفعا» is tamyīz (specification), and the clause «أيهم أقرب» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «تدرون». «فريضة»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied governing word, i.e.: Allah ordained that as an ordinance. The preposition phrase «من الله» is attached to a naʿt of «فريضة»; the clause «إن الله كان عليما» is resumptive; «حكيما» is a second khabar of «كان».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «ولكم نصف» is resumptive; «ما» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «إن لم يكن» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes. The preposition phrase «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الربع». The preposition phrase «من بعد وصية» is attached to an implied «يستحقون» (they are entitled), and the clause «يستحقون» is resumptive. His saying «كلالة»: a ḥāl of the pronoun in «يورث». The clause «وله أخ» is a ḥāl of the pronoun of «يورث», and «غير» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) in «يوصي». His saying «وصية من الله»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted governing word, i.e.: He enjoins you an enjoining; and the preposition phrase «من الله» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «وصية». «حليم» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The wāw is resumptive, the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject), «الفوز» is its khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «ومن يعص» is conjoined to the clause «من يطع» in the preceding verse. His saying «يعص»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the elision of the weak letter. The preposition phrase «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خالدا». The clause «وله عذاب مهين» is conjoined to the clause «يدخله», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The preposition phrase «من نسائكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يأتين»; the preposition phrase «منكم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «أربعة». The clause «فإن شهدوا» is conjoined to the clause «اللاتي يأتين», because the relative noun is equivalent to «إن آتين» (if they commit); the clause «فاستشهدوا» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate), and the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); it enters upon the khabar by likening the relative to the condition; and the verb is an imperative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the elision of the nūn. The preposition phrase «لهن» is attached to the second object of «جعل».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «فآذوهما» is the khabar (predicate) of «اللذان», and the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida). And the clause «فإن تابا» is conjoined to the clause «اللذان يأتيانها», because the relative noun is equivalent to «إن أتياها» (if they commit it).

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The preposition phrase «للذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the notion of existence (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached. The preposition phrase «بجهالة» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يعملون». And the clause «فأولئك يتوب» is conjoined to the clause «إنما التوبة على الله», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: «حتى»: inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), and «إذا» is adverbial-conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its apodosis «قال», and «الموت» is a postponed fāʿil (agent). «ولا الذين» is conjoined to the preceding relative noun, and the conditional clause is parenthetical. The clause «وهم كفار» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, and the clause «أولئك أعتدنا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن ترثوا» is the fāʿil (agent) of «يحل». «كرها»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «النساء». The maṣdar «أن يأتين» is accusative by removal of the preposition «في», i.e.: except in the case of committing indecency; so obstructing them is not permitted in any case except in this case. The clause «فإن كرهتموهن» is conjoined to the clause «تعضلوهن», with no grammatical position. His saying «فعسى أن تكرهوا»: the fāʾ is linking, «عسى» is an inflexible (jāmid), complete (tāmm) past verb, and the interpreted maṣdar is the fāʿil of «عسى». «ويجعل»: the wāw is of accompaniment (maʿiyya), and the verb is accusative by «أن», necessarily implied; and the maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: there may be a prospect of dislike on your part and of Allah's placing good.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: «مكان زوج»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) (استبدال), and the clause «وآتيتم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause. The clause «أتأخذونه» is resumptive, and His saying «بهتانا»: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: «كيف» is an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause «وكيف تأخذونه» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. And the clause «وقد أفضى» is a ḥāl clause, in the position of the accusative, of the wāw in {أَتَأْخُذُونَهُ}.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The preposition phrase «من النساء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما». His saying «إلا ما قد سلف»: «إلا» is a particle of exception, «ما» is a relative noun, a disjoined (munqaṭiʿ) excepted, because the past does not combine with the future. His saying «وساء سبيلا»: the wāw is resumptive, «ساء» is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb of blame; its fāʿil (agent) is a pronoun explained by an indefinite noun accusative as tamyīz (specification), and the one specified for blame is omitted, its implied form being: the way of that marriage.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The preposition phrase «من الرضاعة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أخواتكم». His saying «فإن لم تكونوا دخلتم»: the fāʾ is parenthetical, and the clause is parenthetical, interposed between the two conjoined elements. His saying «وأن تجمعوا»: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to «حلائل». His saying «إلا ما قد سلف»: the exception is disjoined (munqaṭiʿ), because the past does not combine with the future.

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: His saying «والمحصنات»: a noun conjoined to the preceding interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: and your combining two sisters, and the married women. «كتاب الله عليكم»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted governing word, its implied form being «كتب» (He prescribed), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «كتاب». The implied clause «كتب» is resumptive. The maṣdar «أن تبتغوا» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (ishtimāl) of «ما»; His saying «محصنين»: a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «تبتغوا»; His saying «غير»: a second ḥāl. His saying «فما استمتعتم»: the fāʾ is resumptive, «ما» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «استمتعتم» is khabar (predicate). The preposition phrase «منهن» is attached to a ḥāl of the hāʾ in «به». His saying «فريضة»: mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e.: Allah ordained that as an ordinance. And the preposition phrase «من بعد الفريضة» is attached to a ḥāl of the hāʾ in «به».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The preposition phrase «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يستطع». «طولا»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «يستطع», and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن ينكح» is mafʿūl bihi of the nunated maṣdar «طولا». His saying «فمن ما ملكت»: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and the preposition phrase is attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted qualified noun, i.e.: then let him marry a woman being from «ما». The preposition phrase «من فتياتكم» is attached to a ḥāl of the implied returning pronoun, i.e.: which it possesses, being from your maidservants. The clause «والله أعلم» is parenthetical, and the clause «بعضكم من بعض» is a ḥāl of the pronoun of address in «أيمانكم»; the clause «فانكحوهن» is conjoined to the clause of the implied verb «فلينكح». The preposition phrase «بإذن» is attached to a ḥāl of the pronoun «هنَّ»; «محصنات غير» are two ḥāls of the pronoun in «آتوهن». The clause «فإذا أحصنَّ» is resumptive, and «إذا» is adverbial-conditional, attached to the sense of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), i.e.: they are punished with such-and-such when…; the clause «فإن أتين بفاحشة» is the apodosis of «إذا», and the clause «فعليهن نصف» is the apodosis of the second condition. The maṣdar «أن تصبروا» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and «خير» is its khabar (predicate). And the clause of the maṣdar is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The object of «يريد» is omitted, i.e.: the prohibition of what He prohibited; the lām is causal, and the verb is accusative by «أن», optionally implied, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يريد», i.e.: Allah wills the prohibition of what He prohibited, for making clear. «سنن»: second object, accusative. «الذين»: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi, and the preposition phrase is attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause).

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «ويريد الذين» is conjoined to the clause «والله يريد». And the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تميلوا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The clause «وخلق الإنسان» is resumptive. «ضعيفا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الإنسان».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: «إلا»: a particle of exception, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is a disjoined (munqaṭiʿ) excepted. The preposition phrase «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «تراض». And the clause «إن الله كان بكم رحيما» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: «عدوانا»: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative. The clause «وكان ذلك على الله يسيرا» is resumptive, and the preposition phrase «على الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يسيرا».

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «ما» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi; «مدخلا» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the maṣdar (verbal noun) being «إدخالا».

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The clause «للرجال نصيب» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The preposition phrase «مما اكتسبوا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «نصيب». The preposition phrase «من فضله» is attached to a naʿt of the omitted second object, i.e.: something being of His bounty. The preposition phrase «بكل» is attached to «عليما».

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The wāw is resumptive; the preposition phrase «لكل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied second object of «جعل», and the tanwīn is a compensation for an omitted muḍāf ilayhi, i.e.: for every person. «موالي»: the first object of «جعل»; the preposition phrase «مما» is attached to the implied verb «يرثون» (they inherit), and the clause of the implied verb is a naʿt (adjective); «ترك الوالدان»: verb and fāʿil (agent). His saying «فآتوهم»: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), by likening the relative to the condition; and it is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «فآتوهم» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject), in the position of the nominative. The preposition phrase «على كل» is attached to «شهيدا».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The two preposition phrases «على» and «بما» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قوامين». His saying «بما أنفقوا»: «ما» is maṣdar-forming, and the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar. His saying «حافظات للغيب»: the lām is redundant (zāʾida), and «الغيب» is the object of «حافظات». The fāʾ in His saying «فعظوهن» is redundant, and the clause is khabar (predicate). The clause «فإن أطعنكم» is conjoined to the clause «اضربوهنَّ», in the position of the nominative. The preposition phrase «عليهن» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «سبيلا», because it is a naʿt (adjective) placed before the noun it qualifies.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: «شقاق بينهما» are mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and muḍāf ilayhi; the preposition phrase «من أهله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «حكما»; the clause «إن يريدا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: His saying «وبالوالدين إحسانا»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied verb, i.e.: «أحسنوا» (do good). «إحسانا» is mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the implied clause «أحسنوا» is conjoined to the clause «لا تشركوا», with no grammatical position. And the clause «إن الله لا يحب» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: «الذين يبخلون» is mubtadaʾ (subject); its khabar (predicate) is implied: «معذّبون» (will be punished). The preposition phrase «من فضله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the returning pronoun. The clause «وأعتدنا للكافرين» is resumptive. «مُهينا» is originally «مُؤَهْوِنا», an active participle from the augmented triliteral «أهان»; the hamza was elided by analogy with its elision from the first-person imperfect, so it became «مُهْوِنًا»; the kasra of the wāw was transferred to the hāʾ, so it became «مُهِوْنا»; then the wāw was changed into a yāʾ because it is vowelless and the letter before it has a kasra.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: «رئاء» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), interpreted as «مرائين» (showing off), accusative. The preposition phrase «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of «قرينا». His saying «فساء قرينا»: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and «ساء» is treated like «بئس»; its fāʿil (agent) is latent, explained by the indefinite noun accusative as tamyīz (specification), and the one specified is omitted, i.e.: «الشيطان» (Satan). The clause «فساء قرينا» is the apodosis, and the fāʾ is obligatory, because the verb is treated like an inflexible (jāmid) one.

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The wāw is resumptive; «ما» is interrogative, mubtadaʾ (subject); «ذا» is a relative noun, its khabar (predicate); the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e.: «لسعدوا» (they would have been happy); and the conditional clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: «مثقال ذرة»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: a wronging of the weight of an atom's weight. «وإن تك حسنة»: the wāw is a conjunction, «إن» is conditional, and the verb «تك» is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect, jussive (majzūm) with the sukūn implied on the nūn, which was elided for lightening; the noun of «تك» is a pronoun whose implied form is «الذرة» (the atom), and «حسنة» is the khabar (predicate) of «تك»; and the clause «وإن تك» is conjoined to the clause «إن الله لا يظلم».

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The fāʾ is resumptive; «كيف» is an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: so how will they fare? And «إذا» is a pure adverb, governed by this implied verb (يصنعون). «شهيدا»: ḥāl.

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: «يومئذ يودُّ»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يودُّ», and «إذٍ» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, muḍāf ilayhi, and its tanwīn is a compensation for a clause. «لو» is maṣdar-forming, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is the object of «ودّ». And the clause «ولا يكتمون» is conjoined to the clause «يودُّ», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The clause «وأنتم سكارى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and His saying «ولا جنبا»: a single-word ḥāl conjoined to the clause «وأنتم سكارى»; the clause «وإن كنتم مرضى» is conjoined to the clause «لا تقربوا», with no grammatical position. His saying «إلا عابري»: «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «عابري» is a ḥāl, accusative with the yāʾ. The preposition phrase «على سفر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted element conjoined to the khabar (predicate) of «كان», «مرضى». «صعيدا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), on the basis of the verb being made to include the sense of «اقصدوا» (go to).

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The clause «يشترون» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw of the plural, and the price paid is implied (muqaddar), i.e.: with guidance; and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تضلوا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: «وكفى بالله نصيرا»: verb and fāʿil (agent), the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), «نصيرا» is tamyīz (specification), and the clause is conjoined to the resumptive «وكفى», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The preposition phrase «من الذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: «قوم يحرفون» (a people who distort). The clause «يحرفون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم». «غير مسمع»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «اسمع», and «مسمع» is muḍāf ilayhi. His saying «لَيًّا»: a ḥāl, interpreted as «لاوين» (twisting). The maṣdar (verbal noun) after «لو» is the fāʿil of an implied «ثبت» (it were the case). The clause «لكن لعنهم» is conjoined to the implied «ثبت» after «لو»; the clause «فلا يؤمنون» is conjoined to the clause «لعنهم الله», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: «مصدقًّا»: an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial); the lām after it is redundant (zāʾida), and «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle, accusative. His saying «كما لعنَّا»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi; the implied form is: We curse them with a cursing like Our cursing.

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: «دون» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause).

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The clause «بل الله يزكي» is resumptive; His saying «فتيلا»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: a wronging of the measure of a date-stone's thread; and the clause «ولا يظلمون» is conjoined to the clause «بل الله يزكي».

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: «كيف»: an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial), governed by «يفترون»; the clause «يفترون» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), on the basis of «انظر» being made to include the sense of «علم» of the heart (mental knowing); the clause «وكفى به» is resumptive, the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), the hāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), and «إثما»: an accusative tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The preposition phrase «من الكتاب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «نصيبا». The clause «يؤمنون» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw of the plural. The preposition phrase «من الذين» is attached to «أهدى», and «سبيلا» is an accusative tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: «أم» is disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa), for digression (iḍrāb), and the clause is resumptive. His saying «فإذاً»: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if they were given, then they would not give; «إذًا» is a particle of answer, and «الناس نقيراً» are the two objects of «يؤتون». The clause «فهم لا يؤتون» is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position, and the clause «لا يؤتون» is the khabar (predicate) of the implied mubtadaʾ (subject).

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: The clause «أم يحسدون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. And the clause «فقد آتينا» is conjoined to the clause «يحسدون», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The clause «فمنهم من آمن به» is conjoined to the clause {يَحْسُدُونَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: «كلما نضجت جلودهم بدَّلناهم»: «كل» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «بدَّلناهم», and «ما» is maṣdar-forming and temporal, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi, i.e.: We replace their skins every time their skins are roasted through; the clause «نضجت» is the ṣila of the relative particle, and the clause «بدّلناهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «نصليهم». His saying «غيرها»: an accusative naʿt (adjective). His saying «ليذوقوا»: the lām is causal, and the verb is an imperfect, accusative by «أن», optionally implied after the lām, and the maṣdar is genitive by the lām, attached to «بدَّلناهم»; and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: «خالدين»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «سندخلهم», and the preposition phrase «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) it; His saying «أبدا»: an adverb of time attached to «خالدين»; the clause «لهم أزواج» is a ḥāl of the hāʾ in «سندخلهم», in the position of the accusative; and the clause «وندخلهم» is conjoined to the clause «لهم أزواج», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تؤدوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition bāʾ. His saying «وإذا حكمتم بين الناس أن تحكموا»: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذا» is an adverb stripped of the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يأمركم»; and the maṣdar «أن تحكموا» is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar «أنْ تُؤَدُّوا», i.e.: He commands you to render the trusts and to judge with justice; so the conjunction and the conjoined element have been separated by the adverb, and this is permitted. His saying «نعمَّا»: «نعْم» is a past verb of praise, and its middle radical was originally vowelless; when «ما» came after it and the mīm of «نعم» was assimilated into it, the middle radical was given a kasra because of the meeting of two vowelless letters; «ما»: a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent) of «نعم»; and the one specified is omitted, i.e.: the rendering of the trust.

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The clause «أطيعوا» is the response to the vocative, resumptive. The clause «فإن تنازعتم» is conjoined to the clause «أطيعوا», with no grammatical position. The clause «إن كنتم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. And the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes.

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: The clause «يريدون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يزعمون», in the position of the accusative. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يتحاكموا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «وقد أمروا» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl of the fāʿil of «يريدون», and the maṣdar «أن يكفروا» is accusative by removal of the preposition bāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: «تعالوا»: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the elision of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). The clause «قيل» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and «إذا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) its apodosis. The clause «رأيت» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position, and the clause «يصدون» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: «فكيف»: the fāʾ is resumptive, and «كيف» is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: how will they fare? The clause «فكيف» is resumptive. The clause «يحلفون» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl of the wāw in «جاءوك». «إن» is negating, and «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr). And the clause «إن أردنا» is the answer to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: His saying «إلا ليطاع»: «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), the lām is causal, and the verb is accusative by «أن», optionally implied, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أرسلنا». His saying «ولو أنهم»: the wāw is resumptive, «لو» is a particle of impossibility due to impossibility, «أنَّ» is an abrogating particle (nāsikha), and the interpreted maṣdar is the fāʿil (agent) of «ثبت»; the clause «ولو ثبت أنهم» is resumptive. «إذ» is an adverb attached to «جاءوك». And the clause «لوجدوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: The fāʾ is resumptive, «لا» is negating, the wāw is a particle of oath and governs the genitive, and «ربك» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أقسم» (I swear); the second «لا» is redundant (zāʾida), for emphasis; the oath clause is parenthetical, and the clause «لا يؤمنون» is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position. The preposition phrase «مما» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «حرجًا».

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: «أن اقتلوا»: «أن» is explicative, and the clause after it is explicative. His saying «إلا قليل»: «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «قليل» is a badal (substitute) of the wāw. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أنهم فعلوا» is the fāʿil (agent) of an implied «ثبت», and the clause is conjoined to the clause «ولو أنَّا كتبنا»; and the noun of «كان» is a pronoun referring to the action understood from «فعلوا».

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The wāw is a conjunction, «إذًا» is a particle of answer. The lām occurs in the apodosis of an implied «لو», i.e.: if they had stood firm, We would have given them. The clause «وإذًا لو ثبتوا» is conjoined to the clause {وَلَوْ أَنَّا كَتَبْنَا}. And the clause «لآتيناهم» is the apodosis of the implied condition, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The wāw is a conjunction, and the lām occurs in the apodosis of the preceding implied condition; the clause «ولهديناهم» is conjoined to the clause «آتيناهم», with no grammatical position. His saying «صراطاً»: second object.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: The preposition phrase «عليهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «أنعم», and the preposition phrase «من النبيين» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun of «عليهم». The clause «حسن أولئك رفيقًا» is resumptive, and «رفيقًا» is tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: «ذلك»: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); «الفضل» is a badal (substitute), and the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The clause «وكفى بالله» is resumptive; the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), the Divine Name is the fāʿil (agent) of «كفى», and «عليما» is tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The clause «خذوا» is the response to the vocative, resumptive. «ثبات» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. And «جميعا» is an accusative ḥāl.

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: The preposition phrase «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). «لمن»: the lām is for emphasis, and «من» is a relative noun, the noun of «إنَّ». The lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath, and the verb is an imperfect, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. The clause «فإن أصابتكم» is conjoined to the clause «إنَّ منكم لمن». His saying «إذ لم أكن»: an adverb of time attached to «أنعم», and the clause «لم أكن» is muḍāf ilayhi, in the position of the genitive.

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The wāw is a conjunction, the lām paves the way for the oath (mūṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), «إن» is conditional, and the clause is conjoined to the clause «إن منكم لمن». His saying «كأن»: lightened from the heavy form and operative; its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), its implied form being «كأنه»; and the clause is parenthetical; the clause «لم تكن» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of «كأن»; and «يا» in «يا ليتني» is for drawing attention. His saying «فأفوز»: the fāʾ is causal (sababiyya), and the verb is accusative by an implied «أن». The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: there is a wish for my being present and so winning.

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: The fāʾ is resumptive, and the lām is for command; its original vowel is kasra, and making it vowelless is a lightening. And the clause «فيقتل» is conjoined to the clause «يقاتل».

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: His saying «وما لكم لا تقاتلون»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the clause {فَلْيُقَاتِلْ}, with no grammatical position. «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the clause «لا تقاتلون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «لكم». His saying «الظالم أهلها»: a naʿt (adjective), and «أهلها» is fāʿil (agent) of the active participle. His saying «لدنك»: an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive, attached to a ḥāl of «وليًّا».

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: «قيل»: a passive past verb; its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a pronoun referring to its maṣdar (verbal noun), and the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. The clause «فلما كتب عليهم القتال» is conjoined to the clause «ألم تر», with no grammatical position; «لمَّا» is a particle of consequence upon consequence; «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and «فريق» is mubtadaʾ (subject); it is indefinite, and what permits it is «إذا». The preposition phrase «منهم» is attached to a ṣifa (adjective) of «فريق», and the clause «إذا فريق» is the apodosis of the condition «لما». His saying «كخشية الله»: the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: a fearing like the fearing of…, and «خشية» is muḍāf ilayhi. His saying «أو أشدَّ»: a noun conjoined to «خشية», the implied form being: or like a stronger fearing; and «خشية» is tamyīz (specification). «لِمَ كتبت»: the lām is a preposition, and «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to the verb; its alif was elided because the preposition is attached to it. «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). His saying «فتيلا»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e.: a wronging of the measure of a date-stone's thread; and the clause «ولا تظلمون» is conjoined to the clause «والآخرة خير», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: «أينما»: a jussive-governing conditional noun, an adverb of place, and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida); it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the complete (tāmm) «تكونوا», and «تكونوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the elision of the nūn. His saying «ولو كنتم»: the wāw is circumstantial, conjoining to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being: it will overtake you in every state, even if you are in this state; and this is for exhausting the states. «لو» is a non-jussive conditional particle, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes, i.e.: even if you were in lofty towers, it would overtake you; and the clause «ولو كنتم» is a ḥāl clause. His saying «فمال هؤلاء القوم»: the fāʾ is resumptive, «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), the preposition phrase is attached to the khabar (predicate), «القوم» is a badal (substitute), and the clause «لا يكادون» is a ḥāl of «هؤلاء».

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: «ما»: conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «أصابك» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate); the preposition phrase «من حسنة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ما». His saying «فمن الله»: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and the preposition phrase is attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e.: «فهو من الله» (then it is from Allah); the clause «فمن الله» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). His saying «رسولا»: ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause «وكفى بالله شهيدا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and the Divine Name is the fāʿil (agent). «شهيدا» is tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: His saying «فما أرسلناك»: the fāʾ is linking, «ما» is negating. His saying «حفيظا»: an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause «فما أرسلناك» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), in the position of the jussive.

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause «يقولون» is resumptive; His saying «طاعة»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being «أمرنا» (our affair is). The clause «فإذا برزوا» is conjoined to the clause «يقولون». His saying «غير»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the relative noun after it is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «والله يكتب ما يبيتون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause. The clause «فأعرض» is resumptive, and the clause «وكفى بالله» is resumptive; the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and the noun genitive in form is the fāʿil (agent) of «كفى»; «وكيلا» is tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: The hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is resumptive, «لا» is negating, and the clause is resumptive. Likewise the clause «ولو كان». And the clause «لوجدوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: The wāw is resumptive; «لولا» is a particle of impossibility due to existence; «فضل» is mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) being omitted, its implied form being «موجود» (exists); the preposition phrase «عليكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «فضل». «قليلا» is excepted from the fāʿil (agent) of «اتبعتم».

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: The clause «لا تكلف إلا نفسك» is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements. The underlying sense is: Allah does not charge Muhammad except with his own action. «عسى الله»: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, the Divine Name being its noun, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يكفّ» is the khabar (predicate) of «عسى». The clause «والله أشدّ» is resumptive. «بأسا» is tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: «شفاعة» is mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the preposition phrase «منها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «نصيب».

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: The wāw is resumptive; «إذا» is adverbial-conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the sense of the apodosis, and it is not attached to «حيُّوا», because what follows the fāʾ does not govern what precedes it; the implied form is: greeting with something better is obligatory upon you when…. «حييتم» is a passive past verb with its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). And the preposition phrase «على كلّ» is attached to the khabar (predicate) «حسيبا».

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: His saying «لا إله إلا هو»: «لا» is the lā of generic negation, «إله» is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "deserving of worship"; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «هو» is a badal (substitute) of the latent pronoun in the omitted khabar. The clause «لا إله إلا هو» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the Divine Name, and the clause «ليجمعنكم» is the answer to an implied oath. The clause «لا ريب فيه» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of «يوم القيامة». His saying «ومن أصدق من الله حديثا»: the wāw is resumptive, «من» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), «أصدق» is khabar, the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أصدق», and «حديثا» is tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: The fāʾ is resumptive; «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition phrase after it is the khabar (predicate), and the second preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the notion of existence (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached. His saying «فئتين»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf and mīm in «لكم». And the clause «والله أركسهم» is a ḥāl clause.

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: «لو» is maṣdar-forming, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is the object of «ودّوا». «كما»: the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdar-forming, the implied form being: a disbelieving like their disbelieving. The clause «كفروا» is the ṣila of the relative particle. The clause «فلا تتخذوا» is resumptive. His saying «حيث وجدتموهم»: «حيث» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اقتلوهم»; the verb is past, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), the mīm is for the plural, the wāw is a lengthening of the vowel of the mīm, and the pronoun is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: The clause «بينكم وبينهم ميثاق» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم», in the position of the genitive. The clause «حصرت صدورهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «جاءوكم». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يقاتلوكم» is accusative by removal of the preposition (عن). His saying «فلقاتلوكم»: the fāʾ conjoins to the apodosis, and the lām occurs in the apodosis of «لو» to emphasise the link; the clause «ولو شاء الله» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause «فإن اعتزلوكم» is conjoined to the clause «لو شاء الله», with no grammatical position. And the clause «فما جعل» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), in the position of the jussive.

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: The clause «يريدون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «آخرين». «كلما ردوا»: «كل» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أركسوا», «ما» is maṣdar-forming and temporal, the implied form being: they were plunged back every time of being returned to the trial. The clause «ردوّا» is the ṣila of the relative particle. The clause «أركسوا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and likewise the clause «فإن لم يعتزلوكم». The clause «فخذوهم» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), in the position of the jussive. And the clause «وأولئكم جعلنا» is conjoined to the clause «يعتزلوكم».

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: The noun of «كان» is the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يقتل». The khabar (predicate) of «كان» is what the preposition and its genitive noun «لمؤمن» are attached to. His saying «إلا خطأ»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: except a killing by mistake. His saying «فتحرير»: the fāʾ is linking, «تحرير» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar is omitted, i.e.: «فعليه» (then upon him is…); the preposition phrase «إلى أهله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مسلمة». The maṣdar «أن يصّدّقوا» is a disjoined (munqaṭiʿ) excepted, because blood-money is not of the genus of giving in charity. The clause «فإن كان» is conjoined to the clause «من قتل», with no grammatical position. His saying «عدو»: it may be an attribute of the singular and the plural. The clause «هو مؤمن» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause. His saying «فتحرير»: mubtadaʾ, its khabar implied, i.e.: «فعليه», and the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The clause «بينكم وبينهم ميثاق» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم». His saying «فدية»: mubtadaʾ, and the khabar is implied, i.e.: «عليه». His saying «فصيام»: mubtadaʾ, its khabar implied, i.e.: «عليه»; and «توبة» is mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: His saying «متعمدا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يقتل». His saying «خالدا»: a ḥāl of something implied, i.e.: He recompenses him, abiding; it is not a ḥāl of the hāʾ in His saying «فجزاؤه», because the ḥāl and the one it describes are not separated by an extraneous element, namely the khabar (predicate); and the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خالدا». The clause «وغضب الله» is conjoined to the clause «جازاه», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: The conditional clause is the response to the vocative, resumptive. The clause «تبتغون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «تقولوا». The clause «فعند الله مغانم» is conjoined to the clause «لا تقولوا», in the position of the jussive. And the second clause «فتبيّنوا» is conjoined to the clause «فمنَّ».

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: His saying «غير»: a badal (substitute) of «القاعدون», nominative. The clause «فضّل الله» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and «درجة»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: a preferring by a degree. His saying «وكلا»: the wāw is parenthetical, «كلا» is a fronted first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is parenthetical. «أجرا» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq, because it coincides with its verb in meaning, since the meaning of «فضّل» is «آجر» (rewarded).

harrat-mujtaba:96-96.t: «درجات» is a badal (substitute) of {أَجْرًا}, accusative, and the preposition phrase «منه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «درجات».

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: «ظالمي أنفسهم»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun of «توفَّاهم», and «أنفسهم» is muḍāf ilayhi; this annexation is not pure (ghayr maḥḍa), because the muḍāf is an active participle. His saying «فيم كنتم»: «في» is a preposition, «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of the genitive; the alif was necessarily elided because it is attached to the preposition; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «كان». «فتهاجروا»: the fāʾ is causal (sababiyya), and the verb is accusative by an implied «أن»; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, the implied form being: was there not spaciousness in the earth, and so an emigrating on your part? «وساءت مصيرا»: the wāw is a conjunction, the verb is past, the tāʾ is for the feminine, the fāʿil (agent) is the pronoun «هي», and «مصيرا» is tamyīz (specification). The one specified is omitted, i.e.: «هي» (it), and the clause «ساءت مصيرا» is conjoined to the nominal clause «مأواهم جهنم».

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: The clause «لا يستطيعون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «المستضعفين», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:101-101.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تقصروا» is accusative by removal of the preposition (في). The maṣdar «أن يفتنكم» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The word «عدوا» is singular even though a plural is meant by it, because it resembles maṣdars in its pattern, like «القَبول». And the clause «إن خفتم» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes.
